verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents using its CLI with deployment tools to install and configure it across many devices at once. Its REST API and Python module can list all clients and export session data in bulk. However, the multi-device fan-out relies on external deployment tools, and there is no documented native bulk action across many items (e.g., mass-editing aliases, closing many sessions, or batch address-book changes) in the API or portal. Missing for 10: native first-party bulk endpoints or portal multi-select actions, bulk operations beyond install/config and data export, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use CLI commands with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices, without manual setup on each machine.
List all AnyDesk clients registered to the account
Export session data (to terminal or CSV)
